find_package(Qt${QT_DEFAULT_MAJOR_VERSION} REQUIRED COMPONENTS Test Widgets Multimedia Network)
option(QITE_TEST_PLAYBACK "Test decoding with a working WebM/VP8 multimedia backend" OFF)
add_executable(qite_video_test video.cpp)
set_target_properties(qite_video_test PROPERTIES AUTOMOC ON CXX_STANDARD 14)
if(TARGET qite)
    target_link_libraries(qite_video_test PRIVATE qite)
else()
    target_sources(qite_video_test PRIVATE ../libqite/qite.cpp ../libqite/qiteaudio.cpp ../libqite/qitemedia.cpp ../libqite/qitevideo.cpp ../libqite/qitevideoframe.cpp ../libqite/qitevideoframe_p.h)
    target_link_libraries(qite_video_test PRIVATE Qt${QT_DEFAULT_MAJOR_VERSION}::Multimedia Qt${QT_DEFAULT_MAJOR_VERSION}::Widgets)
endif()
target_include_directories(qite_video_test PRIVATE ../libqite)
target_link_libraries(qite_video_test PRIVATE Qt${QT_DEFAULT_MAJOR_VERSION}::Test Qt${QT_DEFAULT_MAJOR_VERSION}::Network)
target_compile_definitions(qite_video_test PRIVATE QITE_TEST_VIDEO="${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/data/test.webm")
add_test(NAME qite_video COMMAND qite_video_test)
set_tests_properties(qite_video PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 45 ENVIRONMENT "QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen;QT_MEDIA_BACKEND=ffmpeg")
if(QITE_TEST_PLAYBACK)
    set_property(TEST qite_video APPEND PROPERTY ENVIRONMENT "QITE_TEST_PLAYBACK=1")
endif()
